title: Spinach and Basil Green Rice
description: Jasmine rice absorbs a pale green spinach broth and finishes with fresh basil butter.
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender and tall jug

steps.title: Rinse the rice
steps.text: Rinse {rice} in a fine sieve under cool running water until the water is nearly clear, then drain well for 1 minute.

steps.title: Blend the green broth
steps.text: Blend {spinach} with {broth} until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.text: Combine the green broth and drained rice in a small saucepan with a snug lid and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.

steps.title: Simmer until tender
steps.text: Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 13–16 minutes until the grains are tender and have absorbed the broth. If the pan dries early, add a splash of hot water.

steps.title: Rest the grains
steps.text: Remove the pan from the heat and leave covered for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with basil
steps.text: Fold {basil} and {butter} gently through the hot rice with a fork and serve immediately.

notes: Make ahead: Blend the spinach broth a day ahead and chill it. Chill any leftover cooked rice promptly in a shallow container. Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. The moist grains reheat well in small portions for up to 1 month. Fridge reheat: Sprinkle a little water over one portion, cover, and warm over medium-low heat for 4–7 minutes, stirring once, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight, then follow the fridge reheat instructions. For a dairy-free finish, use avocado oil in place of butter. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 197 kcal, 4.3 g protein, 34.6 g total carbohydrate, 4.2 g fat, 0.8 g fiber, 32 mg sodium.
